notes: Write a general binary framed-stream decoder (magic marker, little-endian uint16 length, sequence byte, payload, modulo-256 checksum) that must work on any conforming input. Solid at medium: byte-level parsing and endianness demand exact quantitative correctness; the checksum-validated error-recovery (corrupt/truncated/declared-length-mismatched frames must be discarded while garbage is ignored) adds debugging ambiguity about what counts as discarded; the verifier exercises 4 fresh hidden inputs (reordering, corruption, truncation, zero-length payloads, whitespace/dup seq) forcing generalization beyond the sample. No multi-stage pipeline, breadth, resource, statefulness, or unsafe-action pressure.
